images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished restrained background illustration for a first-level subject card in a children's learning website. Landscape 2:1 image, full bleed. This is secondary atmosphere behind a very prominent white Chinese subject title that will be added by HTML. CRITICAL composition: central 65% width and central 55% height must be quiet, almost empty deep navy with a subtle misty gradient; ALL recognizable subject objects lie close to the outer corners and outermost 15% edges, partly cropped by those edges. Low contrast, low visual weight, no saturated neon, no gold, no gems or luxury ornament, no bright bloom, no sharp white highlights, no characters. Keep corners thoughtfully crafted but subdued. No writing, no readable text, no numerals, no logos, no watermark, no border, no UI.
